description.en: Learn body parts and how to say how your body feels.
description.yue: 認識身體部位，學識講身體點樣。

steps.en: This is my hand. I wave hello.
steps.zh: 呢隻係手，我用佢揮手打招呼。

steps.en: These are my eyes. I see with them.
These are my ears. I hear with them.
This is my mouth. I speak and eat with it.
steps.zh: 呢個係口，我用佢講嘢同食嘢。

steps.en: These are my feet. I walk with them.
